settings.text: The Best Women’s Holiday Gifts from Zero Restriction

settings.richtext:
Give her the gift of premium performance. Explore top picks from versatile activewear to best-in-class rain gear, and everything in between.

Need a gift for him? Discover our top 10 for him

settings.title: Hooded Olivia Jacket
settings.content: Made from a superior fabric with a waterproof membrane, the Olivia Jacket offers lightweight, quiet, and breathable protection. Designed to keep you dry and comfortable in any conditions, this rain layer goes anywhere—and packs perfectly.

settings.title: Liv Rain Pant
settings.content: 100% waterproof rain pants, designed to keep you playing in any conditions. They feature an adjustable elastic waistband, and convenient pass-through zippers to reach your pockets underneath. Lightweight and packable, they’re perfect to have on-hand.

settings.title: Mikaela Full Zip
settings.content: Z500 with multi-directional stretch, exceptional softness, and continual warmth, the Z500 double jersey knit is the ultimate layering fabrication. A flattering cut and easy full zip feature make Mikaela the perfect mid-weight layer.

settings.title: Tess Vest
settings.content: The Tess is an especially unique combination of fabrics for flexibility, extended comfort, and the perfect fit. Panels quilted with windproof "Cloud" and Primaloft® base cut the wind, while stretch-knit side panels form to the body for a sleek and comfortable fit.

settings.title: Sofia Pullover
settings.content: A best-selling stretch layer for any and every activity. Flexible and breathable, throw this pullover on whenever you need a little extra warmth. Details like the thumb holes, back vent, and zip pocket set it apart—and make it an essential you’ll find yourself reaching for every day.

settings.title: Jade Leggings
settings.content: Performance you’ll live in, all day and every day. For upward-facing dog or dog walks, the Jade legging is made from a stretchy holds-you-in fabric that fits and flatters. Design details like hidden side pockets and stitching at the cuffs make this the pair you’ll want in multiples.

settings.title: Elsa Down Jacket
settings.content: Peak performance. Reach for Elsa and you’ll get a grey goose down-filled, water-repellent, and fully lined layer with all the features you need to reach new heights. Superior thermal regulation keeps you warm in any conditions, down to the snug wrist cuffs and adjustable drawcord hood. Versatile and practical, take it with you on every adventure.

settings.title: Sadie Skort
settings.content: Supportive and comfortable, this skort is a golfer’s must-have. Stay cool and dry with moisture-wicking fabric, and feel secure with interior shorts that stay in place while you play. This skort comes with plenty of pocket storage, and built-in UPF 50+ sun protection. It’s a versatile style that’s thought of everything.

settings.title: Saige Vest
settings.content: Whether you’re logging miles or meeting friends for brunch, our Saige vest is an easy match for jeans, joggers, or leggings. The insulated, channel-quilted design will keep you warm to your core, while the water-resistant, windproof fabric ensures that not even Mother Nature can ruin a good outfit.

settings.title: Nicki Windbreaker
settings.content: A true windbreaker. Fully windproof with a water-resistant coating, Nicki sets you up for success wherever you’re headed. It features an adjustable hood and hem so you can find your perfect fit, plus elastic cuffs that keep the elements out. A breathable back vent cools you off on your afternoon run, and the lightweight stretch fabric always keeps up.
